newsitem.title: UK: London shares open firm, tracking Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: London shares open firm, tracking Wall Street.

text.p: UK shares were moderately higher at the opening bell with investors cheered by Wall Street's strong performance overnight.
The FTSE's near-term upside is seen limited, however as investors await further corporate earnings data.

"We've had some disappointing trading statements over the past few weeks. Companies have been blaming sterling for the shortfall and the pound keeps going higher," the head of trading at a major investment bank said.
The FTSE 100 index was up 13.9 points at 4,318.2.0 by 0837 GMT. The March FTSE futures contract rose 12.0 to 4,313.
